question: Five persons are sitting in a straight row, facing North. K and N are sitting at the two extreme ends. R is sitting to the immediate left of L. M is sitting to the immediate left of N. K and L are the immediate neighbours of R. What is R's position when counted from the extreme left end?
solution:
Given: Five persons are sitting in a straight row, facing North.

K and N are sitting at the two extreme ends.

M is sitting to the immediate left of N.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/edeefb024e5a8ab3bf6a1d172ca68fc05a06950cc8e6d40083a39f333b9f609f.png] 

R is sitting to the immediate left of L.

K and L are the immediate neighbours of R.

Final arrangement:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1cf3376d6d82842bce386d48a26903789bf1e70709b3291cc101623f1df538a7.png] 

So, R's position when counted from the extreme left end is **Second**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Second**".
